'''Rongqing''' is an NPC in {{location|Jinzhou}}. He is studying penjing design, and currently interns at [[Bogu's Arbor]]. He can be found at the building above the Jinhzou Theater stage and Bogu's Arbor at night.

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Rongqing''' Ms. Verina's designs are truly enchanting. If only I could be her...
:'''Rongqing''' What sets her apart from me...

==Dialogue==
;(Set 1)
:'''Rongqing:''' It feels like something's missing here. So strange. I've incorporated all the decorations I could think of...
:'''Rongqing:''' Miniature models, amber pebbles, moss... I've used them all, so what could be lacking?
:'''Rongqing:''' Looks like I'll have to ask Ms. Verina to come and take a look. Her designs always emit a vibrant energy that's simply unmatched.
----
;<nowiki>18:00-05:59 at Bogu's Arbor</nowiki>
:'''Rongqing:''' Hmm... how can I make this penjing more alive...
:'''Rongqing:''' Maybe I can put a pebble here, some moss there, and then add a miniature penjing...?
:'''Rongqing:''' Darn it. No matter how I craft it, it still looks so artificial.
:'''Rongqing:''' How does Ms. [[Verina]] manage to make her penjings look so naturally dynamic? What's her secret?
:'''Rongqing:''' The next time she swings by, I'll have to figure it out.
----
;<nowiki>06:00-17:59 by upstairs, Jinzhou Institute</nowiki>
;(Gather flower during daytime)
:'''Rongqing:''' Please stop!
:'''Rongqing:''' The penjing here is meticulously crafted to blend in with the Institute's surroundings. Plucking any of these flowers would throw off the entire aesthetic.
:'''Rongqing:''' If you love these flowers, feel free to come and enjoy their beauty, but please don't destroy my design.
----
;<nowiki>06:00-17:59 at Bogu's Arbor</nowiki>
;(Gather flower at night when Rongqing isn't around)
:'''Beneath the night sky, the flowers exude an enchanting allure. Unconsciously, you reach your hand out...'''
:'''As you snap out of your daze, a soft touch envelopes your fingers. Nestled in your palm lies a little flower, adorned with dewdrops, its presence serene yet captivating.
----
;<nowiki>06:00-17:59 by upstairs, Jinzhou Institute</nowiki>
;(Talk to Rongqin during day after picking flower)
:;'''Rongqing''' Hmm... That's strange...
:'''Rongqing:''' Huh? Who picked a Dewvetch? Now the entire penjing is ruined! I've invested so much time into this graduation project.
:'''Rongqing:''' *Sobbing* The defense is just around the corner. Where am I supposed to find another Dewvetch now?
{{Dialogue End}}
